profile.name: Rudra Tiwari
profile.role: Building agent infrastructure & scientific ML systems
profile.bio: I build tools and research systems for coding agents, developers, and scientific discovery. Current work includes ANCP for agent-native compiler interaction, TRIADS for materials ML, and practical infrastructure for real developer workflows.
profile.status: Open to research conversations and collaborations

about.title: About
body: I build public systems across agent infrastructure, developer tooling, scientific machine learning, and focused product experiments. The common thread is turning messy workflows into something concrete: protocols agents can use, models researchers can test, and tools developers can actually run.

I operate this work through both my personal account and independent orgs: TwentySevenLabs for agent/dev infrastructure, Catalyst Zero Research for materials and scientific ML, and Rtx09x for experiments, apps, research notes, and fast shipping.
Away from the terminal, I am still usually building something: RC planes, PC builds, hardware setups, videos, songs, and whatever new rabbit hole is too interesting to leave alone.

work.title: Work
work.lede: Agent infrastructure, scientific ML, and tools that are useful outside the demo.

featured.name: ANCP
featured.desc: Agent Native Compiler Protocol: an open, spec-first protocol that gives coding agents a stable machine-readable interface for compiler diagnostics, repair plans, safe fixes, and verification loops across languages.

featured.name: TRIADS
featured.desc: A parameter-efficient recursive attention architecture for materials-property prediction in small-data regimes. Code, pretrained weights, and benchmark results paired with a linked Zenodo preprint.

archive.name: Agentic Provider Gateway
archive.desc: Provider-agnostic model infrastructure: routing, adapters, capability metadata, structured outputs, normalized tool calls, streaming, usage accounting, trace storage.

archive.name: Agentic Skills
archive.desc: High-agency agent skills for executable specs and end-to-end shipping — the public skill layer behind clearer planning and ship-ready workflows.

archive.name: Munchkin
archive.desc: Cross-platform multi-account manager for Codex, Gemini, and Qwen CLIs with encrypted storage, fast switching, quota tracking, and load balancing.

archive.name: supergit
archive.desc: Lightweight terminal Git assistant: init, commits, sync, branch switching, and undo flows with guided prompts and safer defaults.

archive.name: CuriosityCache
archive.desc: Public research notebook and knowledge garden: AI, compression, neuroscience, transformers, and adjacent topics feeding longer projects.

archive.name: Piko
archive.desc: Tiny AI focus companion for Chrome. Lightweight, focused, and easy to try.

archive.name: Parameter Golf
archive.desc: OpenAI Parameter Golf work: small LM training, compression constraints, and PR-frontier analysis under the 16MB limit.

archive.name: Meow-Mocks
archive.desc: Web-based mock test platform driven by JSON exam definitions: timed exams, review flow, results breakdowns, analysis views.

archive.name: YouTube TLDR
archive.desc: Distraction-blocking Chrome extension that redirects YouTube viewing into an AI-generated summary first.
